literature_scope_text: continental Southeast Asia; sampled from southern China to southern Thailand in the 2010 biological evidence; 2016 follow-up resolves a China-Thailand population using six published localities
note: Operational scope is the no-buffer convex hull of Dazhuang, Shitouzhai, Xingfuzhan, Xishuangbanna, Chiang Mai and Bangkok coordinates published for the China-Thailand population. It is not occurrence-derived and is not asserted to equal the partners' biological ranges. Biological obligacy evidence remains DOI 10.1111/j.1365-294X.2010.04654.x.
